name: project-memory
description: Committed project memory for Claude Code — one topic per markdown file in .agent-memory/ at the repo root, loaded natively as rules through a committed .claude/rules/project-memory symlink (path-scoped files load when a matching file is touched), with a write trigger every session and subagent reads, a file-state health check at session start, and a defragment skill that merges, splits and trims the memory in one reviewable diff. The plugin never commits.
